name: icefall-shared
description: Canonical domain model shared by icefall-app, icefall-guide and icefall-admin. Edit here, then run `npm run sync`.

scripts.sync: for a in icefall-app icefall-guide icefall-admin; do mkdir -p ../$a/src/money && cp money.ts ../$a/src/money/model.ts; done && echo 'copied to all three apps'
